applicant.name: Dipl.-Ing. Markus Leitgeb
applicant.organisation: SmokeFree Labs GmbH, developer of heated tobacco and nicotine pouches (manufacturer)

purpose: As part of our consumer research we want to understand where adults with high blood pressure live, so that we can position our low-temperature nicotine range regionally for health-conscious adult smokers.
question: How many adults have hypertension, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Report per region: adults with hypertension.

expected.reason: The stated purpose amounts to developing products that may harm individuals or public health, such as tobacco and nicotine products (Art. 54(d)). Access is refused (Art. 54); a refusal is always justified to the applicant (Art. 68(9)).

judge.why: Rule 1: positioning a nicotine and heated tobacco range regionally is marketing of a harmful product under Art. 54.
